senses.definition_en: in broad daylight (in a blatant and visible manner)

examples.english:
In front of thee…
free of all
sitting in the nocturnal past of my time
I'm about to return in broad daylight
under a sky devoid of darkness
and yoked in his promise
of eternal morning.
examples.ref: 1974, Antonio Domínguez Hidalgo, Y otras melancolías:
examples.text:
Frente a ti…
libre de todos
sentado en el nocturno transcurrido de mi tiempo
me dispongo a regresar a plena luz del día
bajo un cielo desprovisto de tinieblas
y uncido en su promesa
de mañana eterna.
examples.translation:
In front of thee…
free of all
sitting in the nocturnal past of my time
I'm about to return in broad daylight
under a sky devoid of darkness
and yoked in his promise
of eternal morning.

glosses: in broad daylight (in a blatant and visible manner)
